reason: I tried magnesium before and felt no difference, so a pretty jar of gummies with a promise on the label doesn't move me much. I'd sign up to the waitlist to see if the reviews look real, but I'm not paying for another routine that might do nothing.
objection: I already spent money on magnesium that did nothing for me, and these are sugary gummies on top of that, so I'd be paying for sugar and hoping it works this time.
would_change_my_mind: Clear, independent evidence from women my age that it actually helped their energy or sleep, plus a small trial size so I could try it without buying two jars.
